goal: 松光启动器 Windows 本机离线质量闭环 — G2/G4 有限返工（LQ-01..LQ-06）

lq.title: 取消意图被当成服务端确认取消

red.instrument: independent import-terminal disproof (unchanged expectations, rebound to this round's copy)

lq.fix: ui/js/launcher.js handleImportFiles: cancelRequested (intent) and cancelConfirmed (server-confirmed) are separate; the terminal branch only claims cancellation for err.cancelled===true or a server-confirmed cancel; a plain failure reports an explicitly unconfirmed outcome (new i18n key import.outcomeUnconfirmed, zh+en).

lq.title: 实际输入变化仍可复用旧成功结果
lq.fix: run-goal-validation.ps1 Test-InputSet: the manifest is parsed and every entry is re-checked against the actual execution root (existence + integer size + SHA256); a verified input-set fingerprint is bound into the run binding and into every stage fingerprint. Empty/duplicate/rooted/missing/malformed entries are refused.

lq.title: 接受旧TRX及没有实际执行测试的计数
lq.fix: Each attempt runs in a freshly created attempt directory, so a TRX can only be the one this child wrote; counters must be present, non-negative and mutually consistent with the UnitTestResult row census; executed=0 is never a pass.

lq.title: 必需产物变化没有参与stage指纹
lq.fix: produces is part of the length-prefixed stage fingerprint, and reuse additionally requires every declared required output to exist with the recorded SHA256. The R3 stage file binds the real tests assembly, VerifyHost.exe and VerifyHost.dll.

lq.title: 不兼容Resume覆盖旧记录且沿用旧runId
lq.fix: run-binding.json binds runId + input-manifest SHA + verified input-set SHA + stages-file SHA + execution root. An incompatible resume refuses before touching anything (exit 2, refusal-*.json); attempt evidence is never overwritten, superseded records are archived and previous verdicts are kept in verdicts/.

lq.title: 空执行列表也生成整体PASS
lq.fix: Empty stage lists, unknown -Only selections, duplicate stage ids and missing requiredStages are refused (exit 2); a legal -Only subset yields an explicit PARTIAL verdict and exit 3, which is not an overall completion.

limitations: Real Avalonia/WebView2 GUI, real Minecraft, native credential backends, real update handover, cross-platform and remote CI/release remain unverified.
The C# figure is the authorised 13+5+6+49=73 selection; ImportWithALiveTokenButCancelledMidway stays excluded and no full C# suite is claimed.
RA-01/RA-02 (restricted recovery-safety counter-proofs) stay out of scope per the earlier platform boundary.
Builds and tests ran only inside the GUID execution copies, never in D:\松光启动器.
closingStatement: 具备独立复验条件，等待 Codex 独立验收
